stem:
Sana studies the expression $57-19$.

Which two claims correctly identify its terms?

options.text: Call the plus-sign idea the terms, with no named parts of $57-19$.
Rewrite as $57+(-19)$; the terms are $57$ and $-19$.
The terms are the addends after rewriting the subtraction as addition of the opposite.
Report only the printed digits $5$, $7$, $1$, and $9$ as the terms, ignoring how $57-19$ is grouped.

teacher.key_rationale: Terms are parts separated by plus after rewriting subtraction as adding the opposite: 57 and -19. Digits alone or an empty plus-sign idea are not the terms.
